about: openrouter's decision table (the P3 procedure). Three surfaces of one gateway, each a turn the World's scenario scripts once (openaiWire.scenario, the Messages surface read by anthropicWire's reader), else the labeled stub: THE TWIN RUNS NO MODEL. The key a request is made with is read back from the World's key; the catalogue is the models our applications name, as openrouter.ai's pages state them; a person's application key comes from OAuth PKCE on the /auth page (a screen). Every other operation is unmodeled.

decisions.demand: Substrate's chat example (Pi), Volter Harness's model calls, Volter Editor's OpenCode and Pi on BYOK coding, LibreChat's OpenRouter endpoint
decisions.why: an action: a turn on the kernel's OpenAI wire with OpenRouter's facts (a gen- id, the provider, native_finish_reason, reasoning when asked, usage with cost 0, the PROCESSING keep-alive and a final usage chunk when streamed); a model id of the wrong form and a request with no messages refused Models are the dated catalogue; unknown or not-yet-released models are refused.

decisions.demand: Volter Editor's Claude Code on BYOK coding (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL https://openrouter.ai/api)
decisions.why: an action: a turn on the kernel's Messages wire, streamed as its events or whole; its key checked by the kernel before scenario matching with the declared Anthropic auth wire Models are the dated catalogue; unknown or not-yet-released models are refused.

decisions.demand: Volter Editor's Codex on BYOK coding (wire_api responses)
decisions.why: an action: a turn on the kernel's Responses wire, streamed as its events or whole; a model id of the wrong form and a request with no input refused Models are the dated catalogue; unknown or not-yet-released models are refused. OpenRouter is stateless: store true and previous_response_id are refused.

decisions.demand: Volter Harness's check after login and in doctor; Volter Editor's check of a saved OpenRouter credential
decisions.why: a computed read of the key the request is made with: its masked label, its creator, no limit, usage 0 (the twin charges nothing); a key the World never issued, or disabled, refused 401 by the manifest's auth

decisions.demand: LibreChat's OpenRouter endpoint (models.fetch: true, each model's pricing into its token config)
decisions.why: a stateless lookup: the twin's catalogue (no stored resource), filtered and ordered by snapshot-backed parameters; controls requiring live routing/policy/benchmark facts are refused and paged by offset and limit, each model with its page's prices, context and output; no key needed Models are the dated catalogue; unknown or not-yet-released models are refused.

decisions.demand: Substrate's vibecode connection and Volter Harness's login --oauth
decisions.why: an action: the code the /auth page issued exchanged once, within ten minutes, against its S256 or plain challenge, for a new key of the person who approved; a wrong method 400, a wrong verifier, a spent or expired code 403

decisions.demand: the World application's OPENROUTER_API_KEY (the descriptor's credentialDoor): Substrate's chat example, LibreChat, Volter Editor and Volter Harness given a key
decisions.why: a key is made on openrouter.ai's Settings > Keys, not through the API our applications call

decisions.demand: the person who approves an application on /auth (vibecode, Volter Harness's login)
decisions.why: a person signs up at openrouter.ai; no API makes one

decisions.demand: a person's own key, pasted into Volter Editor's credential panel or Volter Harness's login
decisions.why: a person makes a key on Settings > Keys, shown once; the keys API is a management key's, outside what our applications call
